scope: read-only follow-up for cached context recovery; no cache edits during output-head windows
facts: vLLM get_computed_blocks caps a hit at request.num_tokens - 1, including generated context on resume
vLLM append_output_token_ids updates the full block hash chain
native HybridKVManager _input_keys and fine_keys include only original prompt hashes; _slot_key returns None past those keys
native plan_reuse caps its hit at prefill_len - 1 even when a request has generated outputs
cache_computed cannot publish generated full blocks without their keys
limitation: These are maximum full-group bounds, not proven recoverable mixed-cache hits. All sliding-window/EAGLE state, retention and tier-availability checks must also pass. Do not claim the example necessarily yields a one-token tail.
